description: Cross-implementation vectors of @valuescan/copy-contract (ValuescanCopyTrading 1.0.0 behind an ERC1967Proxy). Generated by packages/copy-contract/tools/gen-vectors.ts; checked against the contract by contracts/test/CrossCheckVectors.t.sol and against viem by packages/copy-contract/test/vectors.test.ts. Integers above 2^53 are decimal strings.
testOnly: THE PRIVATE KEYS IN testKeys ARE PUBLIC TEST KEYS (keccak256 of the label). Anyone can sign with them. Never fund them, never use them on any chain. Nothing is deployed: the addresses below exist only inside the Foundry test EVM.

steps.name: Owner transferOwnership(timelock): step 1 of Ownable2Step
Multisig schedules acceptOwnership on the timelock
Multisig executes it one second early (reverts TimelockUnexpectedOperationState)
Multisig executes acceptOwnership after 48 h: the timelock owns the proxy
Multisig schedules upgradeToAndCall(V2, 0x): the public 48 h notice
The multisig cannot upgrade directly (reverts OwnableUnauthorizedAccount)
Multisig executes the upgrade after 48 h
F's pre-signed UnsubscribeAll still lands after the upgrade (the EIP-712 domain is unchanged)
